extraction.name: Arabic-Nougat
extraction.description: A suite of OCR models designed to convert Arabic book pages into structured Markdown text, including three specialized models: arabic-small-nougat, arabic-base-nougat, and arabic-large-nougat. These models are fine-tuned using a synthetic dataset, arabic-img2md, consisting of 13.7k paired samples of Arabic book pages and their Markdown representations.
extraction.creator: Mohamed A. Rashad
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was generated by scraping HTML content from the Hindawi website, converting it to PDFs, and extracting Markdown text to create paired samples of Arabic book pages and their Markdown representations.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: HTML content scraped from the Hindawi website, which was then converted to PDFs and processed to extract Markdown text.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: HTML content from Hindawi website was converted to PDFs, and Markdown text was extracted to create paired samples.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: HTML content was scraped from the Hindawi website, converted to PDFs, and Markdown text was extracted to create paired samples of Arabic book pages and their Markdown representations.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: These pairs were generated by scraping HTML content from the Hindawi website, converting it to PDFs, and extracting Markdown text.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The models and datasets contribute to the digitization of underrepresented languages like Arabic and provide valuable resources for Arabic NLP and OCR research.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The arabic-img2md dataset, derived from Hindawi's web content, may not generalize well to other domains of Arabic text, such as scientific, religious, or historical documents.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset may not generalize well to other domains of Arabic text beyond the Hindawi web content. Documents with highly irregular or multi-modal layouts, such as those containing dense tables, charts, or images, may require additional preprocessing or model adaptations. The computational resources required for training are significant.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training OCR models for Arabic text extraction and Markdown conversion. The dataset was exclusively used to train arabic-base-nougat and arabic-large-nougat. For practical applications, arabic-base-nougat is recommended for general text extraction tasks and arabic-large-nougat for lengthy or complex documents.

description.evidence: We introduce Arabic-Nougat, a suite of OCR models designed to convert Arabic book pages into structured Markdown text. Building on Meta's Nougat architecture, Arabic-Nougat includes three specialized models: arabic-small-nougat, arabic-base-nougat, and arabic-large-nougat. These models are fine-tuned using a synthetic dataset, arabic-img2md, consisting of 13.7k paired samples of Arabic book pages and their Markdown representations.

rai:dataBiases.evidence: Dataset Biases: The arabic-img2md dataset, derived from Hindawi's web content, may not generalize well to other domains of Arabic text, such as scientific, religious, or historical documents. Expanding the dataset to include diverse genres and styles is critical for improving model robustness.

rai:dataLimitations.evidence: Dataset Biases: The arabic-img2md dataset, derived from Hindawi's web content, may not generalize well to other domains of Arabic text, such as scientific, religious, or historical documents. Expanding the dataset to include diverse genres and styles is critical for improving model robustness. Complex Layouts: Although Arabic-Nougat handles standard book layouts effectively, documents with highly irregular or multi-modal layouts, such as those containing dense tables, charts, or images, may require additional preprocessing or model adaptations. Scalability Challenges: The computational resources required for training arabic-large-nougat are significant, which could limit accessibility for researchers and practitioners without access to high-performance hardware.

rai:dataUseCases.evidence: This dataset was exclusively used to train arabic-base-nougat and arabic-large-nougat. For practical applications, we recommend using arabic-base-nougat for general text extraction tasks and arabic-large-nougat for lengthy or complex documents.
